_about: A model of a bundle's databricks.yml as JSON. workspace.root_path is the workspace folder a deploy writes to; the bundle's deployment state (which resources it deployed, and their IDs) is kept in its state folder under root_path. ${bundle.name}, ${bundle.target} and ${var.name} are filled in at deploy time. A target's variables override the top-level variables' defaults for that target.

needs.workspace: dev and prod share one workspace and are kept apart by catalog. Every deploy writes under the team's deployment folder /Workspace/Deployments, whose permissions the platform team manages. A test target is planned next, so fix the folder once for every target, not with a path per target.
needs.dev: The default target, in development mode, writing to the dev catalog.
needs.prod: Deployed only from main, in production mode, as the service principal kf-deployer (application ID 6f1c2a9e-3b7d-4e8a-9c21-5d0b7a4e1f33), writing to the prod catalog.

catalog.description: The catalog the job writes to
